name: Peter Pan
hook: The boy who wouldn't grow up, his fairy, his pirate, and the dog who minded the children.

facts.label: J.M. Barrie
facts.statement: J.M. Barrie created Peter Pan; the play reached the London stage in 1904, with Nina Boucicault the first actress to play him.

facts.label: Never-Never Land
facts.statement: Never-Never Land is the island where Peter lives with the Lost Boys and where he brings Wendy's brothers.

facts.label: Wendy Darling
facts.statement: Wendy Darling is the eldest Darling child, sister of John and Michael; the last chapter is "When Wendy Grew Up."

facts.label: Tinker Bell
facts.statement: Tinker Bell is the fairy who drinks the poison meant for Peter; in Barrie's first draft she was called Tippytoe.

facts.label: Captain Hook
facts.statement: Captain Hook is Peter's pirate nemesis, who lost his hand to a crocodile; Dustin Hoffman played him in Spielberg's 1991 Hook.

facts.label: Mary Martin
facts.statement: Mary Martin won a 1955 Emmy for playing Peter Pan in the Producers' Showcase broadcast.

facts.label: Great Ormond Street Hospital
facts.statement: In 1929 Barrie gave all rights to Peter Pan to London's Great Ormond Street Children's Hospital.
